title: Shared Mobility Platform Blueprint
description: Master system architecture for SAFAR — powering intelligent, regulated, and accessible transit across Jammu & Kashmir.

children.title: Matching & Optimization
children.description: Algorithms and workflows optimizing vehicle scheduling, corridor load balancing, and real-time demand-supply coordination.

children.title: Dynamic Dispatch & Corridor Allocation
children.description: Intelligent assignment of stage carriages to high-density corridors (e.g. Srinagar–Budgam, Anantnag Express) based on commuter queues.

children.title: Real-Time Fleet & ETA Telemetry
children.description: Sub-second GPS telemetry and Haversine velocity computation delivering predicted arrival windows for unorganized local transit.

children.title: Multi-Modal Vehicle Fleet Harmonization
children.description: Unified scheduling spanning Mini-Buses (22 seats), Big Buses (42 seats), Tata Magic (7 seats), Shared Vans, and E-Rickshaws.

children.title: Safety & Trust
children.description: Protocols, emergency response pipelines, and verification mechanisms safeguarding commuters, drivers, and conductors.

children.title: Instant Emergency SOS & Geo-Dispatch
children.description: Direct real-time telemetry dispatch to Police PCR 112 and Regional Transport Authority emergency response desk.

children.title: Cryptographic Ticket & QR Verification
children.description: Offline-verifiable digital transit receipts with SHA-256 integrity tokens to eliminate fraudulent fares.

children.title: Driver Behavior & Telemetry Auditing
children.description: Continuous velocity tracking, geofence compliance monitoring, and automated safety alerts on hazardous mountainous corridors.

children.title: Financial & Pricing Models
children.description: Transparent, regulated fare computation engines and offline revenue reconciliation pipelines.

children.title: Distance Slab Schedule (SRO-97 / MVD)
children.description: Official statutory distance tiers: 0–3km (₹9), 3–5km (₹14), 5–10km (₹17), 10–15km (₹20), 15–20km (₹26) + per-km rates beyond 20km.

children.title: Offline Sync Ledger & Background Sync
children.description: IndexedDB transaction buffer that records bookings during connectivity blackouts and syncs seamlessly via Service Worker BackgroundSync.

children.title: Automated Conductor Shift Reconciliation
children.description: Live shift earnings computation and passenger boarding ledger for conductors and stage-carriage fleet operators.

children.title: Engagement & Incentives
children.description: Concessions, loyalty programs, and gamified dispatch incentives promoting public transit adoption.

children.title: Student & Senior Concession Mandates
children.description: Automatic 50% discount enforcement for students with valid institutional photo IDs and senior citizen transit passes.

children.title: Conductor Shift Pings & Punctuality Bonuses
children.description: Performance metrics rewarding drivers and conductors who maintain consistent GPS broadcasts and on-schedule departures.

children.title: Multilingual Voice & Chat Transit Assistance
children.description: Accessible AI transit guidance in Kashmiri (कॉशुर / کٲشُر), Urdu, Hindi, and English.

children.title: Regulatory & Legal
children.description: Regulatory compliance, dispute resolution frameworks, anti-overcharging safeguards, and green transit mandates.

children.title: Overcharging Redressal & Anti-Grievance
children.description: Direct passenger-facing official fare validation display to eliminate unauthorized surcharges by private stage-carriage operators.

children.title: Strict CSP & Zero-Tracking Privacy
children.description: Strict nonce-based Content Security Policy, zero unsafe-inline styles, zero third-party tracking, and client-side data isolation.

children.title: EV Transition & Feeder Vehicle Standards
children.description: Specialized regulatory fare tariffs and priority corridor integration for zero-emission E-Rickshaws and E-Autos.
